title: Reading what you type (cin)
instructions: std::cin >> n; waits for the person to type something, then puts it into the box n.
Here, what the program reads comes from the answers box under the Run button. It starts with 7. Try other numbers!
Notice the arrows: << sends words out to the screen, >> brings what was typed in.
task: Read a number into n. With the answer 7, the program shows what you typed and then:  Double is 14
hint:
Bring the typed number into the box:

    std::cin >> n;
